items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden; ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt.
items.computation: The letter is dated (posted) 20.11.2026, a Friday. Under §41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, a letter from a German authority sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the one-month period to file Klage (§74 VwGO) runs from 25.11.2026 and ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month with the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). That day is not a Sunday or a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies. Note: the decision text itself is dated 18.11.2026, two days before the letterhead date of 20.11.2026; if the authority actually posted it on or shortly before 18.11.2026, the real deadline could fall a day or two earlier than computed here.

warnings: The Bescheid is dated 18.11.2026 inside the text ('mit diesem Bescheid vom 18.11.2026') but the letterhead and posting date is given as 20.11.2026; if posted earlier than 20.11.2026, the one-month Klage deadline could fall a day or two before 24.12.2026, so check the envelope postmark and consider filing a few days early as a safety margin.

No Widerspruch is possible here ('ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt'); only a direct Klage before the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg is available, which has formal procedural requirements, so get advice (a lawyer or a Verbraucherzentrale/Mieterverein) well before the deadline.
This tool computes the deadline only; it cannot draft or file the court action.
